# Gameswelt — basic tactics

- Original source: [Gameswelt — basic tactics](https://www.gameswelt.de/robin-hood/tipp/robin-hood-112844)
- Author / publication: Michael Beer / Gameswelt
- Language / date: German; 2003-01-12
- Access: Indexed article text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

This short contemporary tips article recommends changing attack patterns, prioritizing officers and archers, and favoring incapacitation and restraint to encourage recruitment. It also suggests luring mounted enemies into trees, coordinating bait and ambush characters with quick actions, and keeping camp workers occupied.

Additional advice concerns repeated payments to beggars, rooftop movement, and the poor effectiveness of arrows against heavy armor. The claim that enemies adapt to repeated strikes is a useful comparison point for the combat guide, but has not been verified against the engine here.

The article is practical general advice rather than a mission-by-mission walkthrough.
